failure_bucket_taxonomy.name: file_not_queued_or_run_not_executed
failure_bucket_taxonomy.summary: the file never reached the orchestrator pipeline; the apparent Unknown is a UI state confusion rather than a classifier outcome
primary_signals: no run card rendered for the file at all
active_run absent or active_run.results does not contain a record matching the operator session
secondary_signals: operator did not press the run trigger after upload
queue page shows the file as pending rather than complete

failure_bucket_taxonomy.name: text_extracted_but_classifier_cues_insufficient
failure_bucket_taxonomy.summary: the extractor returned a non-empty text payload but no rule fired in the document classifier, so the safe default unknown_medical label was assigned
primary_signals: selected_extractor is a text-based extractor, not an OCR fallback

failure_bucket_taxonomy.name: ocr_fallback_needed_but_not_triggered
failure_bucket_taxonomy.summary: the document required OCR (image-based PDF or low text-layer quality) but the gate did not switch to OCR for it
secondary_signals: language_text_visibility indicates low visibility despite low ocr_quality_band

failure_bucket_taxonomy.name: document_family_unsupported
failure_bucket_taxonomy.summary: the document is a legitimate clinical record but its family is outside the currently supported classifier coverage (no rule maps cues onto a labeled family)
primary_signals: document_family_classification_diagnostic indicates an unsupported family hypothesis or null

failure_bucket_taxonomy.name: image_or_table_or_layout_heavy_document
failure_bucket_taxonomy.summary: the document is dominated by images, scanned tables, or complex layout that the current text/table extractors cannot resolve
primary_signals: ocr_gate_reason references image-heavy or layout-heavy content
selected_extractor is a fallback OCR engine that completed but produced sparse text
secondary_signals: ocr_gate_fallback_executed == True with sparse downstream cues
operator_reason_label references OCR or extraction-quality concerns

failure_bucket_taxonomy.name: language_or_script_mismatch
failure_bucket_taxonomy.summary: the document is in a language or script that the current cue packs fail to cover adequately for this document family
primary_signals: language_text_visibility indicates a non-English / Cyrillic / mixed script
document_type still resolves to 'unknown_medical' despite Cyrillic / mixed signal
secondary_signals: operator_reason_label references language or script handling

failure_bucket_taxonomy.name: parser_unsupported
failure_bucket_taxonomy.summary: the parser layer rejected the upstream payload (for example unsupported file type, encrypted PDF, malformed structure) before the classifier had a chance
secondary_signals: ocr_gate_fallback_executed False with no fallback engine selected

failure_bucket_taxonomy.name: ui_run_state_confusion
failure_bucket_taxonomy.summary: the operator interpreted a stale or unrelated run as their result, or a session refresh discarded the active_run state
primary_signals: Run ID label inconsistent with the file the operator believes was processed
run card timestamp older than the operator session
queue page disagrees with the run-results page
secondary_signals: operator reports the failure after a tab close / browser refresh
operator inspected a run from a different document
multiple files in the same batch produced overlapping Unknown labels and the operator selected the wrong card

decision_tree.question: is there any run card for the file at all (active_run.results contains a matching entry)?
is validation_status equal to 'empty'?
decision_tree.yes: bucket B7 (parser_unsupported) if selected_extractor reports parser failure; else B3 (ocr_fallback_needed_but_not_triggered) or B5 (image_or_table_or_layout_heavy_document)

decision_tree.question: is validation_status equal to 'review_ocr_quality' or is ocr_quality_band low?
decision_tree.yes: bucket B3 (ocr_fallback_needed_but_not_triggered) if ocr_gate_fallback_executed is False; else B5 (image_or_table_or_layout_heavy_document)

decision_tree.question: is cyrillic_ocr_recommended True or does language_text_visibility indicate non-English / Cyrillic / mixed?
did the extractor return text yet document_type resolves to 'unknown_medical' with confidence approximately 0.30 and operator_review_reason == 'unknown_document_type'?
decision_tree.yes: bucket B2 (text_extracted_but_classifier_cues_insufficient) if cues should plausibly cover this family; else B4 (document_family_unsupported)
decision_tree.no: review individual fields and re-route via secondary signals; if none fit, record the anomaly for the next triage block

operator_action_required_steps: open the failing run card in the local UI
expand the advanced diagnostic panel for that card
read the 20 advanced diagnostic fields off the card without copying any raw text, filename, or path into any public report
apply the decision tree in section E of this report
record the matched bucket id (B1 through B8) in a private operator note
if any bucket maps to a 'conditional' code fix, request a follow-up evaluation block by id (eval block only; no behavior change)
if the matched bucket is B1 or B8, no code change is justified
